# mktemp

Create a unique temporary file or directory through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/mktemp -p . sample.XXXXXX

moonx cli/mktemp -d -p . sample.XXXXXX
```

Create exclusively and print the path. Templates need at least three consecutive X characters in their final X run.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d`, `--directory` | create a directory |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | suppress creation and output errors |
| `-p VALUE`, `--tmpdir VALUE` | use DIR, then TMPDIR, then /tmp |
| `--suffix VALUE` | append SUFFIX to a template ending in X |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
| `-t` | use DIR, then TMPDIR, then /tmp |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Unsafe -u dry runs are unsupported. Suffixes cannot contain path separators.
- Without an explicit destination, TMPDIR or /tmp must name an existing directory.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
